# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### 1. Pure functions in `core/`, no DOM/network side effects

- Every `src/core/*.js` module (`context.js`, `payload.js`, `phone.js`, `validation.js`, `whatsapp.js`) takes plain values in, returns plain values out — no `document`, `fetch`, or `window` mutation. `context.js` and `whatsapp.js` accept `win`/context objects as *parameters* rather than reading globals directly.
- Verified in ≥2 files: `src/core/phone.js` (`onlyDigits`, `normalizeWhatsapp`, `isValidBrazilianWhatsapp`, `formatPhoneForDisplay` — all string-in/string-out) and `src/core/payload.js` (`buildLeadPayload`, `getLeadTopic`, `hasRequiredPayloadShape` — object-in/object-out).
- Keeps `tests/unit/` fast and DOM-free-testable even though `vitest.config.js` runs `jsdom`.

### 2. Dependency injection via default parameters for testability

- Functions/classes that touch the environment accept an injectable default instead of reading the global directly: `LeadWidget` constructor takes `win = window` (`src/ui/widget.js:11`); `createGlobalContext(win = window)`, `getTrafficOrigin(win = window, ...)`, `readProductContext(element, win = window)` (`src/core/context.js`); `postLead(webhookUrl, payload, { fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl || globalThis.fetch, ... })` (`src/integrations/webhook.js:8`); `createElementFromHtml(html, doc = document)` (`src/ui/template.js:1`).
- Enables `tests/unit/webhook.test.js` and `tests/unit/context.test.js` to pass fakes without a mock library (confirmed absent in `package.json` devDependencies).

### 3. ESM named exports only, no default exports

- Every module across `src/core/`, `src/ui/`, `src/integrations/`, `src/config.js`, `src/index.js` uses `export function` / `export const` / `export class` with named exports; `src/index.js` re-exports `initWhatsAppLeadWidget` as `init` (`export { initWhatsAppLeadWidget as init };`).
- `package.json` sets `"type": "module"`; `eslint.config.js` sets `sourceType: 'module'`, `@eslint/js` `recommended` ruleset applies to `src/**/*.js`, `tests/**/*.js`, `*.js`.

### 4. Config via single merge factory, not a class hierarchy

- `src/config.js` exposes one `DEFAULT_CONFIG` object and one `createConfig(overrides = {}) => ({...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...overrides})` — no builder, no subclassing, no per-feature config classes.
- Behavior toggles (`disableForm`, `redirectMode`, `onRedirect`, `fetchImpl`, `now`) are plain config keys consumed by `src/ui/widget.js`, keeping the extension point flat.
